en.summary: A roomier, easier Smart AI Assistant, still offline.
items: More chatting space: a compact header, a slim one-line message box with a round Send button, and a full-screen Maximise.
Saved conversations: start a new chat, search, rename or delete from a side list (a drawer on phones).
Clearer answers with less repetition, and your new question stays at the top with room for the answer.
School records can still only be changed by you on the normal pages; the Assistant refuses to change them.

sw.summary: Msaidizi Mahiri mwenye nafasi zaidi na rahisi zaidi, bado bila intaneti.
items: Nafasi zaidi ya mazungumzo: kichwa kidogo, kisanduku chembamba cha ujumbe chenye kitufe cha Tuma cha duara, na Kupanua skrini nzima.
Mazungumzo yaliyohifadhiwa: anza mazungumzo mapya, tafuta, badilisha jina au futa kutoka orodha ya pembeni (droo kwenye simu).
Majibu wazi zaidi bila kurudia, na swali lako jipya linabaki juu likiwa na nafasi ya jibu.
Rekodi za shule bado zinabadilishwa na wewe tu kwenye kurasa za kawaida; Msaidizi anakataa kuzibadilisha.
